protocol: PROTOCOL_V3.md Addendum H, lens payoff (the shape of the bet); in sample only

windows.early: entries before 2018-02-01 (reported separately, not a criterion)

costs.fp: r2.costs(sym) on the stored FP frame
costs.stress: spread x1.5 frame (apply_spread_mult) and r2.costs(sym, 1.5), orders rebuilt on the stressed quotes (same as r2.run mode 'stress')

broker_minimum_stop: an order whose initial stop distance (the stop actually used) is closer than 3 x the spread of its fill bar (ask - bid of that bar, in the run's own frame) is NOT TAKEN: it is removed before the simulation, so it does not block later signals.  For every variant the share of refused orders is reported, and a diagnostic run without the refusal gives the share of the trades it would have taken whose stop is that close
censoring: trades still open at the end of the in-sample frame (non-crypto: exit at the last bar by time or eod) are excluded from every statistic, reference and variants alike (one donch4h_stop and one orb trade in the reference)

pooled_ten_sleeves_context.note: monthly sums of R of the ten sleeves at one risk unit per trade, common window, FP costs; context only, not a criterion; 'sharpe-best' was not declared before the run

shape_track_quoted.what_it_found: results/r2/shape (48 variants, whole in-sample period, FP costs): targets at 0.5-3 R raise the share of winning trades and cut the expectancy (T0.5 keeps 6-25 % of it on 9 sleeves); half-and-half exits keep 42-90 %; break-even at +1 R (BE1) changes the expectancy by +6 % (noise30), +7 % (ocm4), -3 % (brk72 btcusd), -5 % (F1 btcusd), -36 % (orb) and lowers the win rate; the selection kept half-target variants on 5 sleeves for their win rate at 87-95 % of the expectancy
